implementation.public_path: Live soft-body resources execute the production realtime-single-step schedule instead of the former blanket PM_ERROR_FEATURE_NOT_PRESENT rejection.
implementation.fixed_tick: One 1/60 predictor, one predicted-surface skin, one common spatial build/query/publication, eight shape/link/apply sweeps, contacts after sweeps 2/4/6/8, one velocity commit and one final surface skin.
implementation.common_epoch: F8-10 swept soft-body surface triangles occupy reserved ranges of the same published spatial epoch used by rigid, liquid and cloth resources; the soft-body solve performs no rebuild, refit, sort or query.
implementation.volume_shape: The frozen F8-14 shape matcher is the public soft-body representation's volume-retention operator; no unexposed tetrahedral material or second solver was introduced.
implementation.collision_consumer: The four frozen F8-14 contact projections consume a cleared canonical per-node view. Rigid/soft contact generation and reciprocal exchange remain F8-45.
implementation.atomic_state: Node positions, velocities and surface positions publish only after successful resource, snapshot and spatial commit. Exact-limit failure leaves public bytes unchanged; replacement and reset renew generation/revision identity.
implementation.adapters: CPU, CUDA, Vulkan and Metal dispatch bindings call the common F8-10/F8-14 Slang entries; no adapter contains private soft-body equations.
